title: Silence Your Doubt | A Discipline Short Film
lines: There's a voice in his head. It says, you can't.
It's loud at 3 a.m. It's convincing.
But he has learned something about that voice.
It speaks loudest right before growth.
Doubt isn't a stop sign. It's a signal that you're close.
So he thanks the voice, and does the work anyway.
Action is the only thing that quiets doubt.
